project_type: Turborepo monorepo (npm workspaces, NOT pnpm): Fastify TypeScript API (apps/api), Prisma data package (packages/db), shared catalogues (packages/shared). CAMPASS ERP platform on top of a live GatePass app, on a live Supabase Postgres (ap-south-1 pooler).
language: TypeScript on Node (ESM, "type": "module"; imports use .js specifiers).
build_system: npm workspaces + Turborepo. QUIRK: @campusgate/shared must be rebuilt (cd packages/shared && npx tsc) so its dist is current BEFORE apps/api and packages/db/seed consume new catalogue keys/schemas. Prisma client is generated from repo ROOT: npx prisma generate --schema=packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma. Prisma is pinned at 6.19.3 — do NOT upgrade to the 8.x RC the deploy log advertises. Build-time @types/* live in dependencies (not devDependencies), per apps/api/package.json.
test_framework: Vitest (apps/api). apps/api/vitest.config includes src/**/*.test.ts only; packages/shared has no runner, so shared-catalogue meta-tests live under apps/api/src/services/__tests__. Real-DB suites (tenant-escape integration, any live-DB behavioral/regression tests) hit live Supabase and read apps/api/.env (campass_app DATABASE_URL, RLS-subject) + packages/db/.env (postgres DIRECT_URL, RLS-bypass admin client).
build_command: From repo root, in order: npm ci; (cd packages/shared && npx tsc); npx prisma generate --schema=packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma; (cd apps/api && npx tsc); npm run build
test_command: cd apps/api && npx vitest run   (single file: npx vitest run <path>)
verification_instructions: After each FEAT: rebuild shared if it changed, regenerate the Prisma client if the schema changed, then `cd apps/api && npx tsc` must compile clean (NOTE: apps/api tsc is NOT expected clean until FEAT-002 wires the new routes — FEAT-001 leaves shared+db+migration green and runs only the catalogue/audit meta-tests), then run the FEAT's targeted vitest files. FEAT-003 runs the full CLEAN build sequence + full `npx vitest run` and must be all green. MIGRATION: do NOT run `prisma migrate dev` (plain OR --create-only) against shared Supabase — the live _prisma_migrations ledger has a pre-existing, harmless checksum drift on the FROZEN 20261019053533_superadmin_security row that can trip migrate dev into a RESET prompt (forbidden). Hand-author the migration.sql in house style, confirm modelled DDL with read-only `npx prisma migrate diff --from-url "$DIRECT_URL" --to-schema-datamodel packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma --script`, then apply with `cd packages/db && npx prisma migrate deploy` (deploy does NOT re-verify applied-migration checksums, so it tolerates the drift — proven by Phase 1). Retry transient pooler errors (P1001 / 'tenant or user not found' / 'Can't reach database server') — the free tier pauses on inactivity. If migrate deploy reports NEW drift, STOP and diagnose; never force-reset the shared DB.
snapshot_or_generated_files: The Prisma client under node_modules/.prisma + @prisma/client is regenerated by `prisma generate` (not committed). The migration directory packages/db/prisma/migrations/<ts>_phase2_sis/migration.sql IS committed. No other generated-and-checked-in artifacts.
environment_constraints: Work on main, NO git worktree. Do NOT push or deploy. NEVER stage or modify apps/api/.env or packages/db/.env (live Supabase secrets the escape suite needs). Shared Supabase DB is LIVE with real data (e.g. bhavishya@demo.edu) — the migration is strictly additive and the SEVEN existing migrations are FROZEN (never edited). campass_app role stays NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS — never grant BYPASSRLS. Commit specific files only; never commit .env. Windows/PowerShell shell.
contribution_requirements: Phase completion gate (docs/roadmap.md): per-module DoD passes; the cross-tenant escape suite is EXTENDED to every new tenant-owned table (student_profile_history, student_documents) incl. the deliberately-buggy-query backstop + three-GUC fail-closed + the RLS-forced policy meta-test, and passes; new permissions registered in the catalogue AND bound to template roles AND seeded in the new migration with the EXACT catalogue-sync markers; the new migration dir added to SEEDING_MIGRATION_DIRS in catalogue-sync.test.ts; important actions write AuditLog v2 via recordAuditEvent(input, tx) INSIDE the withTenant tx; schema changes shipped as ONE versioned migration with RLS/FKs in the SAME migration. Do NOT edit packages/shared/src/modules.ts.
key_patterns: Decision A: SIS is FOUNDATIONAL institution-layer data — new routes are requirePermission(...)-gated ONLY, NEVER requireModuleActive(...) (verified: academics routes on admin.ts/student.ts already follow this). Tenancy (docs/tenancy.md §4): every tenant-owned table carries institutionId + @@unique([id, institutionId]) + @@index([institutionId]); cross-tenant links use composite FKs INCLUDING institutionId (migration DROPs Prisma's single-col FK and re-adds the composite), ON DELETE RESTRICT for ownership, SET NULL for informational links. RLS house style (phase1_academics/superadmin_security/module_system migrations): DO $$ ENABLE+FORCE then nullif(current_setting('app.current_institution_id', true), '')-guarded fail-closed policies; standard pair = tenant_isolation_select (FOR SELECT) + tenant_isolation_modify (FOR ALL); append-only pair (audit_events / academic_calendar_day_revisions) = tenant_isolation_select + <table>_tenant_insert (FOR INSERT) with NO modify policy, plus REVOKE UPDATE,DELETE from campass_app and a BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE trigger (function <t>_append_only() raising restrict_violation + trigger <t>_no_update_delete) binding every role. GRANT refresh guarded by IF EXISTS (pg_roles ... 'campass_app'). Catalogue-sync meta-test parses the migration's INSERT INTO "permissions" ... ON CONFLICT and INSERT INTO "role_permissions" ... AS m( blocks and unions across SEEDING_MIGRATION_DIRS — new permissions must be seeded with those EXACT markers AND the new migration dir added to that array. recordAuditEvent(input, tx) writes inside the withTenant tx; action keys validated against AUDIT_ACTION_KEY_SET (no pg enum / migration mirror) + the AuditActionKey literal-union type + the audit-actions.test.ts KEY_RE meta-test. withTenant(institutionId, fn) pins the tenant GUC transaction-locally; every tenant read/write MUST go through it. getStudentInTenant(userId, institutionId, tx) resolves ownership by the authenticated userId, never a request-supplied id (used by all student.ts self-service reads). Services take a passed Prisma.TransactionClient/DbClient and keep transition/precedence logic as pure functions for DB-free unit tests (see module-system.ts / academic-session.ts). server.ts registers routes as app.register(x, { prefix: "/api/<name>" }) — admin SIS routes go at /api/students, self-service stays at /api/student/me/*.
directory_structure: packages/shared/src: permissions.ts (PERMISSIONS + ROLE_PERMISSIONS + PermissionKey), audit-actions.ts (AUDIT_ACTIONS + AUDIT_ACTION_KEY_SET + AuditActionKey + LEGACY_AUDIT_ACTION_MAP), validation.ts (zod schemas + inferred types), modules.ts (module registry/deps — FROZEN for this task), index.ts (barrel re-exporting all of the above). packages/db: prisma/schema.prisma (all models/enums; StudentProfile at ~line 381, Institution ~197, Program/AcademicSession/AcademicTerm ~713-780), prisma/migrations/<ts>_* (7 FROZEN dirs + the new phase2_sis), src/index.ts (prisma/privilegedPrisma/breakGlassPrisma/withTenant/withSupportGrant/DbClient), src/seed.ts (demo institution; BCA dept code 512, B.Tech-CSE 501; Phase-1 session 2026-2027 + terms + programs). apps/api/src: middleware/auth.ts (authenticate + RequestAuth/request.user {userId,institutionId,...}), services/ (authz.ts getStudentInTenant, authz-engine.ts requirePermission/requireModuleActive, audit.ts recordAuditEvent/sanitizeMetadata, allowance-engine.ts, reliability-engine.ts, module-system.ts, academic-session.ts, calendar-service.ts; NEW student-sis.ts), routes/ (admin.ts, auth.ts, student.ts, hod.ts, guard.ts, platform.ts, mfa.ts, notifications.ts; NEW students.ts), server.ts (route registration), routes/__tests__/ (tenant-escape integration + helpers/tenant-escape-setup.ts + behavioral/regression tests), services/__tests__/ (catalogue-sync, audit-actions, authz-engine, modules, module-system).
